test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6 Oct 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statement(s) and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statement(s).

**Statements:**

No river is a mountain.

Some mountains are lakes.

All lakes are ponds.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some lakes are not rivers.

(II) Some lakes are mountains.

(III) Some ponds are mountains.

options.text: All the conclusions I, II and III follow
Either conclusion I or conclusion III follows

solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9c139ccf9442f733d4b6b405a78fe644d495c8dc8996e65d14266a919d3dd36.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some lakes are not rivers → Follow (As no river is a mountain and some mountains are lakes. As some part of lakes is common with mountains which cannot be river, therefore it is true.)

(II) Some lakes are mountains → Follow (As some mountains are lakes. As some part of mountains common with lakes, therefore it is true.)

(III) Some ponds are mountains → Follow (As some mountains are lakes and all lakes are ponds. As whole lakes comes in ponds and has some part common with mountains, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, All the conclusions I, II and III follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
